assumptions: All dates are previously exposed development history; this is not independent validation.
Historical security-master publication timing and exhaustive ordinary-share subtype remain provisional. Missing formations block complete results; no forward-fill.
Daily open plus adverse slippage and dated reconstructed ticks is a reference-fill scenario, not actual auction execution.
Zero-activity and one-price bars are non-fill proxies. Intraday circuits, queues and spreads are not certified.
Current delivery fee schedule effective 2026-03-01 is applied to every date as a cost counterfactual, not historical tax reconstruction.
Splits/bonuses retain closure-v4 ex+2 share-availability scenarios. Cash dividends remain nonspendable receivables.
Sale proceeds settle before the following exchange-session open; broker historical cash availability is not established.
Kite subscription costs 500 INR per started monthly cycle. Additional production hosting/model overhead is unknown and excluded, not assumed free.
No certified historical sector labels, no sector-cap claim. No extra announcement alpha filter.
Gross Nifty 500 TRI is a diagnostic, not a costed investable product. Nifty 200/Momentum 30 series are not pinned in current local inputs.
Terminal positions remain marked. Without subsequent exchange-session inputs there is no executable terminal liquidation result.
100 percent research drawdown acceptance remains configurable and does not establish an acceptable live loss mandate.
Entire-day observed volume only reduces scenario fills ex post; it is never a signal or formation-time sizing input.
revision_note: Execution-invariant corrections: pending partial exits retain a holding slot; filled quantity cannot exceed entire observed daily volume. Regressions reproduce both failures. No strategy parameter or source-evidence changes; prior attempts preserved.
